§6Powercell (Medium)§f

§a8× the storage, 4× the transfer, the backbone of mid-game power grids.§f

The §bPowercell (Medium)§f holds §e4,000,000 RF§f and transfers §e1,000 RF/t§f per side. Integrates into existing networks (up to §e729 blocks§f) with the same +0.25× per-block scaling.

§6Upgrade§f: Craft a §bCopy NBT recipe§f, a Powercell (Low) surrounded by §b4× Power Core (Medium)§f + §b4× Redstone§f. §a100% of stored energy is preserved§f.

Wrench I/O, wireless linking with Powercell Cards, and energy retention on break all work the same as Low. The 729-block max is a 9×9×9 cube, which is more than enough for most bases.

§9Note:§f Plan your upgrade during low-load moments so you can hand-carry the buffer to your new Medium network without draining it.
